Author: LolipopJ
Name: MomoTalk
Description: Bring Blue Archive's iconic MomoTalk into FINAL FANTASY XIV! Crafted for every Sensei in Eorzea, MomoTalk turns your in-game friend /tells, Free Company, Linkshells, Cross-world Linkshells, and Static party chats into a faithful Blue Archive messenger — complete with a draggable floating phone button, the signature bouncy opening splash, grouped chat bubbles, Lodestone avatars, editable friend and group notes, optional AI reply suggestions, and per-character local history. Open with /momotalk or tap the floating MomoTalk icon anytime.
Punchline: Blue Archive's MomoTalk in Eorzea — [Yuuka] Sen--se--i! I need you to work harder!
